name: SiteWaterBalanceTracker
tagline: Close your mine's monthly water balance – storages, licences and sign-off in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete site water accounting app for mining: inflows, outflows and month-end storage readings per storage, expected vs measured closing and closure error against tolerance, storage levels vs alert and spill levels with days to spill, licensed extraction and discharge against the water-year allocation, and a Draft → Submitted → Verified → Locked workflow with an independent-verifier rule and period lock.
features: Closure error per storage and site, with tolerance
Storage freeboard, alert/spill bands and days to spill
Licence use, full-year forecast and at-risk flag
Verify, query, lock and re-open workflow with rules
Bulk submit/verify/query with skip reasons and Undo
Transfers excluded from site totals; flow-only elements supported
CSV export, grouping, sorting, search, filters
Demo mode with six months of fictional data
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
